name: scheduler
description: Priority-based scheduler that drains the job queue and dispatches each job to its declaring engine, respecting concurrency limits, fairness windows, and declared performance budgets. Deterministic ordering: same queue snapshot -> same dispatch order (Constitution Principle 4).

inputs.name: tick
inputs.description: Optional { now, max_dispatch } hint. If omitted, runtime advances its own clock.

outputs.name: deferred
outputs.description: [{ job_id, reason }] where reason is one of: concurrency_limit, fairness_window, dependency_not_ready.

side_effects: Updates in-flight job counts per engine
Emits AIOS-EVENT-000012 job_dispatched and AIOS-EVENT-000013 job_deferred

error_codes.recovery: Defer until in-flight jobs complete; reschedule with lower priority.

error_codes.message: Job dependency (declared module_id) is not loaded.
error_codes.recovery: Request capability_routing to load the missing module; defer the job.

examples: scheduler tick on a queue with 3 ready jobs + concurrency_limit=2 -> dispatched=[j1,j2], deferred=[{j3, concurrency_limit}]
